The chef must be in an even position, so the chef is at position 2 and the architect at position 1.  
The snowboarder must be to the right of the musical watcher. If the musical watcher were at position 2, there would be no position to its right for the snowboarder, so the musical watcher must be at position 1 and the snowboarder at position 2.  
Thus position 1 has the architect, watches musical, and skis (since snowboarding is taken).  
Position 2 has the chef, watches fantasy, and snowboards.

Answers:  
- Job of the musical watcher: architect  
- Sport of the musical watcher: skiing  
- Movie genre of the skier: musical  
- Position of the snowboarder: 2  

<solution>architect, skiing, musical, 2</solution>
Final answer: architect, skiing, musical, 2
